svg.title: Anatomy of one entry
svg.desc: The eight sections of an entry in the Unified Semantic Interface Specification (curated/schemas/api-schema.json), in one column. Field type is carried by chip colour and the field count inside the chip, never by a type label. bindings.c, semantics.collective and semantics.formal are drawn opened up in place of their own rows; formal is opened two levels deep, one sub-box per sub-object. Each section title carries a section mark and its own section colour; that colour identifies the section and is reused in the listing and the per-section tables, where chip colour means field type.
svg.text: which PPM, which name, which version of which standard
the type suffixes this entry is generic over
how the call is spelled per language; null = not offered
when and where the call runs; eight of eleven closed enums
every process in the team calls it
single, ..., multiple— minimum level the call needs
cpu, gpu, cpu+gpu— where in code it may be issued
cpu, gpu, cpu+gpu— what hardware does the work
thread, warp, block, device— which scope calls together
init, start, complete, free— MPI-4 procedure taxonomy
local, remote, both— whose state the call touches
what the call means; exactly one of the first four is non-null
— the other three operation classes are equally small
in_place = a documented in-place mode, not incidental aliasing
— null for query and management calls, a real answer
who is involved, and does each one call
one entry per memory access, with its provenance
a handle across create, use and destroy
one entry per argument: role, direction, type, constraints
the argument's role — BUFFER, COUNT, RANK and 28 more
in, out, inout— relative to the caller
runtime may touch it after return
a count, or the sibling parameter holding it
host, device, symmetric_heap (+2)— where it lives
what the returned value represents — the C type does not settle it
ERROR_CODE, RESULT, ...— a status, an object, or a datum
hooks and preconditions for consuming tools
edges to other entries; every value is a model:function_key
